messages.This page should only be accese: This page should only be accesed though the tablet available at the tables in the restaurant. When the customer walks into the store a waiter should bring them to a empty table. A tablet is then produced, either the waiter will bring one or one is available on the table.
messages.For the first step the waiter w: For the first step the waiter will register all customers participating in the dining experience
messages.After the registration is finis: After the registration is finished the tablet will be handed over to the customers, who can start placing orders
messages.When the customer has finished: When the customer has finished their dining experience they can request the bill via checkout
messages.The asigned waiter will then co: The asigned waiter will then come over and finish up the payment manually
messages.Please select what table the gu: Please select what table the guests are seated at.
messages.Register all the customers that: Register all the customers that are seated around the table and will partake in the dining.
